title: Build Authority without changing policy
head: Final evidence commit is the PR head; implementation_head identifies tested code.

github_recheck.parent_ci: All active current-head checks passed; conditional jobs skipped.
github_recheck.base_decision: Continue the staged D stack on corrected D27, preserving owner main. No isolated main compatibility claim.

source_pins.A-15: Existing /api/authority/status GET (top-level EmergencyController state plus engine config) and /api/authority/config POST, authority engine and EmergencyController at base_sha; backend remains unchanged.
source_pins.F-25: No PR found in all-state inventory before publication; navigationCompatibility and exact advanced/emergency destinations remain required.
source_pins.Q-08: Open PR #891 owns broad execution-entry certification; D28 does not alter or claim that certification.

design_reference.inspection: Native Authority frame, UI32 precise control section/notes and light control reference, UI35 handoff inspected in Chrome. Screenshots retained.
design_reference.limits: Not a pixel diff or eight native exports. Complete UI35 coverage frame not inspected.

host_requirements: Authenticated scope-bound request and write permission.
F25 supplies both existing advanced-authority and emergency-controls destinations; navigation callbacks honor cancellation.
Retain controller per authenticated scope; retire on logout or replacement. Never reuse another account transport.
Verify combined production host, existing controls and canonical persistence before activation.

implementation: Canonical integer 1–10 values, continuous native pointer motion until release, keyboard arrows/Home/End, 80ms release snap and reduced-motion override.
All thirteen current categories with readable On/Off/disabled state, 56px rows and 44x40 targets. Off changes membership, never grants permission.

Explicit save; changed-field-only POST after canonical preflight and acknowledgment plus fresh live-status confirmation. An explicit retry resends the previously unconfirmed fields even when already applied in memory.

Unknown/conflict states never replay automatically; explicit reload offers Retry save or Discard retry; permission loss purges values; stale data disables editing and remains visibly stale in read-only mode.

Polling refreshes emergency status while preserving dirty/unknown/conflicting policy drafts and baselines; it defers during pointer gestures and focused controls. Drafts survive remount/shell changes.
Advanced/emergency navigation stays available during read/save failures through the gated F25 host seam.
contract_limits: Existing endpoint has no revision/CAS; an external write between preflight and POST cannot be excluded.
The existing API may apply in-memory before a persistence failure; failed acknowledgments are never labeled Saved.
No backend, advanced-policy, emergency writer, migration or durable recovery engine change.

verification.note: F22 headless export pinned at 9f5b258e8548cd3b481c17b5a1653b20753206a2; see D-27.md for reproducible extraction. Two optional F07/F08 integrations skipped.

commit_hooks.note: Normal license, migration, template, package, related-test and type checks; no bypass or coauthor trailers. Evidence commit also uses normal hooks.

browser.final_build_check: Rebuilt app reloaded; clean slider keyboard focus persisted beyond the five-second polling interval.
browser.note: Initial layout/design evidence retained. Targeted review fixes were browser-checked separately; see review_corrections.browser.

not_run: Combined live authenticated F25 host and production activation
Real authority configuration persistence, policy modification, advanced override or emergency effect
OS reduced-motion setting, physical touch device, screen readers or other browsers
Complete UI35 native coverage exports/pixel comparison
Full repository local suite; current PR CI reported separately

preview.isolation: Loopback-only static fixture server; no daemon, API proxy, user vault or persistent settings. Full-page reload resets in-memory fixtures.

rollback: Remove optional registration or switch back to existing Authority settings UI. Revert card commits if needed; no migration reversal or effect replay.
private_progress: Updated outside product repository; shared Drive roadmap unchanged.

fixes: Read live EmergencyController state from status instead of the stale config copy; preserve policy edits during emergency refresh.
Keep unconfirmed field intent through reload and allow an explicit persistence retry at unchanged values, with conflict and acknowledgment/readback checks.
Keep freshness errors visible in read-only mode, including disabled-control recovery and access loss.
